title: Verified Business Fact
description: Extracted from the inline verifiedFact definition previously duplicated inside sales-lead-turn.schema.json. Single shared contract for a read-only, source-attributed, time-bounded business fact record. No semantic change from the original inline definition — see evaluation/business-facts/eval-plan.md and extraction-equivalence.test.mjs.

factId.description: Reusable fact-identifier type. Referenced by consumer schemas (creator-deliverable, post-production-deliverable, sales-lead) wherever they carry a fact_id/fact_ids_used pointer instead of the full record, so the identifier type cannot drift independently of this schema.
